test_CBMonthBegin_repr: test the CBMonthBegin class repr returns <CustomBusinessMonthBegin> for default and <N * CustomBusinessMonthBegins> for multiplied offsets
test_CBMonthBegin_apply: test the CBMonthBegin class adds business month beginnings to datetime values with correct month rollover
test_CBMonthBegin_holidays: test the CBMonthBegin class skips holidays when adding business months across multiple months
test_CBMonthBegin_rollback_rollforward: test the CBMonthBegin class rolls back and forwards datetime objects to the nearest business month begin date
test_CBMonthEnd_repr: test the CBMonthEnd class repr returns <CustomBusinessMonthEnd> for default and <N * CustomBusinessMonthEnds> for multiplied offsets
test_CBMonthEnd_apply: test the CBMonthEnd class adds business month ends to datetime values with correct month rollover
test_CBMonthEnd_holidays: test the CBMonthEnd class skips holidays when adding business months across multiple months
test_CBMonthEnd_rollback_rollforward: test the CBMonthEnd class rolls back and forwards datetime objects to the nearest business month end date
test_CBM_copy: test the CBMonthBegin and CBMonthEnd classes serialize via copy without loss of equality
test_CBM_eq_normalize: test the CBMonthBegin and CBMonthEnd classes return False for equality when normalize flag differs
